messages:
Naomi (Partnerships PM): quick heads-up — Solstice asked to start a joint POC next week. Need runbook, SSO/SCIM check, and rough cost/latency targets from eng. can we triage?
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): thanks! customer is especially sensitive to data residency (EU-only), and they want single-sign-on + SCIM. goal: ingest docs -> embeddings -> vector search.
Priya (SE): @Alex got it. what's the expected QPS and payload sizes for the ingest? that'll drive Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation.
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): ingest ~200 docs/day initially, peaks to 1k/day during demo. average doc ~50KB, longest ~800KB. QPS during demo ~5 rps for search.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): sounds lightweight. we can do Hosted for demo, but for EU-only requirement we'll need Private or Dedicated in eu-west. tagging @Tara for region/provisioning.
Tara (CloudOps): EU region fine but need to confirm encryption key policy. do they require customer-managed KMS/HSM or is CMEK enough? also egress: will Solstice push data to our endpoint or host behind their VPC?
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): they want CMEK + audit logs. data ingress from their cloud (Azure EU) into our VPC peering if possible.
Priya (SE): OK — two immediate asks for POC runbook: 1) network path (VPC peering/privatelink) 2) auth flow (SAML + SCIM) 3) sample env to demo. I'll draft.
Ron (AE): also need quick pricing delta: hosted POC (ephemeral) vs dedicated reserved for demo (3-week window) — the customer wants a figure to sign off. can eng provide back-of-envelope per-day cost?
Marcus (Solutions Eng): rough calc: hosted inference (embedding + search) ~ $0.10 per 1k tokens for embeddings + serving cost. dedicated small pool (1x A10G equiv) ~ $2,500/month reserved -> prorate 3 weeks = ~$1,750 + bandwidth/egress. I'll put a short table in the runbook.
Naomi (Partnerships PM): include an explicit fallback: if Dedicated provisioning hits schedule risk, fallback to EU-hosted with token limits and explicit SLO warnings. customer ok with degraded throughput?
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): they'd accept slower latency for demo if we document limits. main ask is security/compliance and that data doesn't leave EU.
SecurityBot: automated-checklist: PLEASE ATTACH: security_questionnaire_v2.pdf, DPA template, SOC2 summary. Missing: vendor risk assessment, KMS diagrams.
Tara (CloudOps): for VPC peering we'll need their Azure subscription ID, allowed IP ranges, and egress rules. ask them to open a ticket to infra@redwood for provisioning and share the subnet CIDR.
Priya (SE): drafting runbook now. plan to include: - Step 1: provisioning checklist - Step 2: SAML + SCIM setup snippet - Step 3: sample ingestion script - Step 4: metrics to watch (latency, token rate, KV cache hit rate)
Priya (SE): sample SAML config snippet for their IdP: ```
AssertionConsumerService: https://console.redwood.ai/sso/acs
EntityID: redwood-solstice-eu
Attributes: email, name, groups
```
Marcus (Solutions Eng): sample ingest command for their engineers: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -F "file=@/tmp/contract.pdf"
```
Ron (AE): can someone produce a 1-page customer-facing summary with 3 bullets: cost option A (hosted), B (dedicated), and timeline (provisioning lead times)? I can attach to the quote.
Naomi (Partnerships PM): I'll assemble the one-pager from Marcus' calc + Priya's runbook. Target: send to Alex + customer by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): appreciated. one more: security questionnaire — could you pre-fill the 10 high-priority questions (encryption at rest, key management, access controls, logging, retention)? speeds things up.
SecurityBot: prefilled answers exported: encryption_at_rest: AES-256 (CMEK supported), kms: AWS/KMS or customer HSM via bring-your-own-key, access_controls: RBAC + token scoping, logging: audit logs retained 90 days (expandable), retention: configurable per-tenant. (see /security/poc-templates).
Tara (CloudOps): note on latency: EU-hosted median token latency ~12ms/token for base embeddings; Dedicated reduces variance. include that in the one-pager.
Priya (SE): running quick perf check against sample msft-azure eu dataset; will post numbers in thread once done.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): blocker: Dedicated provisioning SLA currently 7 business days for custom VM profile. if customer needs <5 days we need exec sign-off for expedited provisioning. flagging to @Naomi.
Naomi (Partnerships PM): acknowledged. I'll escalate if we need fast lane. Alex — can you confirm preferred start date for POC and whether firm on <2 week turnaround?
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): preferred start date next Tue (8 business days out). they can be flexible by a week if needed.
Ron (AE): ok that fits normal provisioning. I'll hold the quote pending the one-pager.
Priya (SE): perf run results: embeddings ingest pipeline (50KB docs) -> avg embed time 0.6s/doc, indexing latency ~200ms/query at 5 rps. sharing logs: https://redwood.internal/poc/1729504321/perf (internal).
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): perfect — this is enough for initial approval. thanks team.
Naomi (Partnerships PM): next actions: Priya finalize runbook + samples, Marcus finalize cost table, Tara submit infra ticket once Alex shares subscription IDs, SecurityBot attach security pack. I'll close the loop by tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
Ron (AE): I'll prep quote draft and wait for final numbers.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): added note — include model quantization suggestion if they want lower cost during demo (x2 cost reduction possible).
Alex (Solstice Partner Lead): love that. thanks everyone. I'll send the subscription info and the signed DPA once I have it.
SecurityBot: ticket checklist updated: security_pack_attached, dpa_received=false, vendor_risk_assessed=false.
